title: ZeroDev Earn Beta: Cross-Chain Yield in One Integration
summary: ZeroDev Earn, now in beta, lets wallets and apps offer cross-chain yield. Users enter supported opportunities from assets they hold on other chains.
body_markdown:
Wallets and apps want to offer yield. Their users hold funds in different assets on different chains. Connecting the two means building routing, swaps, cross-chain movement, and protocol deposits, then keeping all of it working together.


[ZeroDev Earn](https://www.zerodev.app/earn) , now in beta, brings that into one integration. Users start with a supported asset on a supported chain and enter a supported yield opportunity on another chain. ZeroDev coordinates every step in between, so your team can focus on the experience inside your app.


**Build around where your users’ funds already are**


A user wants to enter a yield opportunity, but their funds sit in a different asset on a different chain. Supporting that one journey can turn a single feature into a stack of bridge, swap, and protocol integrations.


ZeroDev Earn handles the journey. It pairs[Smart Routing Address](https://www.zerodev.app/smart-routing-address) with orchestrated non-custodial infrastructure to take a supported source asset through the required swaps and cross-chain movement and into the final protocol deposit.


You integrate it as one flow. The source asset, source chain, and destination opportunity all need to be supported.


**A defined starting set**


The launch set includes opportunities on[Aave](https://aave.com/) ,[Morpho](https://morpho.org/) ,[Fluid](https://fluid.io/) , and[Yearn](https://yearn.fi/) . Coverage depends on the specific asset, chain, and destination opportunity, so[check the docs for current supported combinations](https://docs.zerodev.app/onramp/earn/supported-vaults) .


ZeroDev provides the non-custodial routing infrastructure. The protocol or vault provides the yield opportunity. Naming a protocol describes supported functionality and does not imply endorsement. Do your own research about the protocols and vaults before integrating.


**See the full flow**


The[live demo](https://smart-recipe-demo.onrender.com/) runs on testnet and shows a supported asset moving from one chain into a yield position on another.


Ready to evaluate the integration? The[developer quickstart](https://docs.zerodev.app/onramp/earn/quickstart) walks through a full deposit with a standard wallet, from selecting a vault and requesting a quote to tracking the deposit. Building with Smart Accounts? The[usage guide](https://docs.zerodev.app/onramp/earn/usage#using-a-smart-account) shows how to submit the same flow as a user operation.


**Built on the ZeroDev infrastructure you already use**


Already building on ZeroDev? ZeroDev Earn lets your team add cross-chain yield on top of the infrastructure you run today. Already offer yield on one chain? The same funding path can connect supported assets on other chains to a supported destination opportunity.


The best place to start: map where your users hold funds, pick the opportunity you want to offer, and[check whether that combination is supported](https://docs.zerodev.app/onramp/earn/supported-vaults) .


**What beta means**


ZeroDev Earn is launching in beta. Supported assets, chains, and opportunities will change as we learn from early integrations, and we’ll work to keep the docs current as they do. Read the[full disclaimer in the ZeroDev Earn docs](https://docs.zerodev.app/onramp/earn) before you integrate.


**Pricing at launch**


ZeroDev Earn adds no new transaction-level fee at launch. API usage follows[existing credit tiers](https://www.zerodev.app/pricing) , and SRA-routed volume retains existing SRA pricing. This doesn’t make the complete flow free.


**Start with the flow**


[Watch the demo](https://smart-recipe-demo.onrender.com/) ,[check the supported combinations](https://docs.zerodev.app/onramp/earn/supported-vaults) , and[follow the quickstart](https://docs.zerodev.app/onramp/earn/quickstart) . You build the yield experience your users see. ZeroDev coordinates the funding path behind it.


[Watch the Demo →](https://smart-recipe-demo.onrender.com/)
[Read the Quickstart →](https://docs.zerodev.app/onramp/earn/quickstart)
